description: Find SMM panels (wholesale social-media-marketing resellers) tracked by PanelCompare, ranked by score, price, trust, uptime, provider score or catalogue uniqueness, optionally filtered by platform, payment method, feature or minimum trust score. Returns each panel with its trust score (0-100), overall score (0-10), 30-day uptime, provider-meter reading and its PanelCompare page.

feature.description: A feature the panel must offer.

platform.description: Platform slug the panel must sell, e.g. "instagram", "tiktok", "youtube".

name: search_panels
title: Search SMM panels
